full_judgment: 9. Mr. Md. Nawab Ali, learned Advocate-on-Record appearing for the respondents opposes the appeal contending, inter-alia, all the properties involved in both the suits are not same nor the issues are common and as such the trial court rightly rejected the application for stay and the High Court Division in its turn discharged the rule illegally.
